name: nodejs_oclif
description: Node.js CLI coverage via oclif. Three commands exist; two are documented in the README and the nested config:set command is not. Verifies that the Node.js path produces a real coverage signal rather than an empty graph, and that nested command directories resolve to colon-separated names.
notes: 2 of 3 commands documented is 66.7%. The band was previously a loose 20-90 because the reported figure was topic-weighted; counting operations makes it exact. The binding assertion remains that all three commands are discovered and config:set is reported as undocumented. An empty command list is a failure, not a pass.
